# Planizer

> Deterministic static-analysis linter for SQL Server (MSSQL) / T-SQL migrations. It answers,
> before a script runs in production: does it lock the table (Sch-M), does it rewrite the data or
> only metadata, is it reversible, will it fail on re-run or on the target version/edition?
> Offline (no database connection needed), CI-first (exit codes, SARIF 2.1.0, a composite GitHub
> Action), no LLM involved — every rule is a parser (Microsoft ScriptDom) plus a behavior catalog
> that is empirically verified against real SQL Server containers (Developer and Express) in CI.

Quick facts: 53 rules across locking/blocking, rewrite vs metadata-only, reversibility, failure
risk (idempotency, batch/GO, limits, version gates) and transaction/script hygiene. Analyzes
statements nested in IF/BEGIN…END/WHILE/TRY…CATCH. Worst-case defaults: SQL Server 2019 Standard.
Suppress with `-- planizer:ignore RULE_ID reason`; configure via `.planizer.json`.

Typical invocation:
`planizer analyze migrations/ --target-version 2019 --edition standard --output json`
(other outputs: text, markdown, sarif; `--sarif-file` writes SARIF alongside; `--rollback` adds
reverse-script analysis; exit code 1 when findings reach `--fail-on`.)

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, usage, outputs, GitHub Action, rule index
- [Rule pages](docs/rules/): one page per rule — what it checks, why, example, fix
- [Rule engine scope](docs/RULES.md): the 9-section rule taxonomy
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): phases, exit criteria, runtime/distribution plan
- [ADRs](docs/adr/): recorded design decisions

## Key rules (examples an agent is often asked about)

- [MSSQL-RW-002](docs/rules/MSSQL-RW-002.md): ADD COLUMN NOT NULL DEFAULT — metadata-only on
  Enterprise, full table rewrite on Standard/Express
- [MSSQL-LOCK-002](docs/rules/MSSQL-LOCK-002.md): offline index builds — what they block and why
- [MSSQL-REV-001](docs/rules/MSSQL-REV-001.md): irreversible statements (DROP/TRUNCATE/unbounded DELETE)
- [MSSQL-IDEM-001](docs/rules/MSSQL-IDEM-001.md): CREATE without existence guard fails on re-run
- [MSSQL-VER-001](docs/rules/MSSQL-VER-001.md): feature not available on the target SQL Server version
